course.name: spend time (on) doing
course.explanation: spend + 时间 + doing；spend + 时间 + on + 名词。不要在 spend time 后面接 to do。

sentences.zh: 我大部分时间都在看小说。
sentences.en: I spend most of my time reading novels.
sentences.wrong: I spend most of my time to read novels.

sentences.zh: 我昨晚花了两个小时看直播。
sentences.en: I spent two hours watching streams last night.
sentences.wrong: I spent two hours to watch streams.

sentences.zh: 我每天花一点时间练口语。
sentences.en: I spend a little time practicing speaking every day.
sentences.wrong: I spend time to practice speaking.

sentences.zh: 我周末经常花时间待在家。
sentences.en: I often spend my weekends relaxing at home.
sentences.wrong: I spend my weekends to relax at home.

sentences.zh: 我在这份作业上花了很长时间。
sentences.en: I spent a lot of time on this assignment.
sentences.wrong: I spent a lot of time in this assignment.

sentences.zh: 我不想花太多时间刷短视频。
sentences.en: I don't want to spend too much time scrolling through short videos.
sentences.wrong: I don't want to spend time to scroll videos.

sentences.zh: 我今天花了半小时听播客。
sentences.en: I spent half an hour listening to a podcast today.
sentences.wrong: I spent half an hour to listen.

sentences.zh: 我花了一个下午整理笔记。
sentences.en: I spent the afternoon organizing my notes.
sentences.wrong: I spent the afternoon to organize notes.

sentences.zh: 我通常花更多时间读书而不是看电影。
sentences.en: I usually spend more time reading than watching movies.
sentences.wrong: I spend more time to read than watch movies.

sentences.zh: 我想少花点时间玩手机。
sentences.en: I want to spend less time on my phone.
sentences.wrong: I want to spend less time in my phone.
